map.name: Brackenford
map.trouble: Red Corwin's bandits hold the old watchtower on Crow Hill and rob the north road, so the north gate is shut.

guard_bark.specifics: Garrick at the shut north gate, then the gate open again.

first.speaker: Garrick
first.text: Brave enough to walk right up to my gate. But that won't get you through it! Now move along!

again.speaker: Garrick
again.text: I don't see many carts on this road lately.

later.speaker: Garrick
later.text: All honest travelers may pass north again!

bounty_offer.specifics: Ulric the shepherd blew a peddler's sheep horn and called every wolf in the Ashwood down on his fold.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text:
Oh, what have I done?! What have I done!

A peddler sold me a horn for calling my sheep home. I blew it once, and every wolf in the Ashwood came running down on my fold! These wolves will be the death of me!

Kill them, young sir. They lurk in the trees just behind my house. I'll make it worth your while.

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: I still hear that howling. You going?

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text:
Not a howl out there! They're really gone?! Bless you!

Here, take this bow. And if you're headed north, see Halvard in the Moot Hall. He has worse trouble than mine.

journal.text: Find the wolves at Ulric's fold and drive them off.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Wenna the miller's widow: the Urchins stole the mill key and locked her out, and Tobin went after them with her frying pan and never came back.

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
Oh, it's hopeless! Hopeless!

The Urchins from the old barrow east of the ford got into my mill and ran off with the mill key! Now I'm locked out of my own mill! Those wretched Urchins are a plague on honest folk!

Tobin went after them with my good frying pan, and he hasn't come back. Will you go into the barrow and bring back my key? I will offer a worthy reward.

refusal.speaker: Wenna
refusal.text: Don't play coy with me stranger. You're scared, that's all. Tobin went with a frying pan, nothing more. Come back when you've found your nerve.

reminder.speaker: Wenna
reminder.text: It is high time you were on your way. Poor Tobin grows hungrier with every hour he's gone.

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text:
My key! You found my key! Now the wheel can turn again!

May all that is great bless you! Please, take this ankh as a token of my appreciation.

after.speaker: Wenna
after.text: My endless thanks for your trouble!

journal.text: Find the key to Wenna's mill in the old barrow.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Find the key to Wenna's mill in the old barrow.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk: a tease, a worry about Corwin, a jab at the player.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: You're mighty scrawny for a bandit-chaser. Hah, hah, hah...!

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: I hope Corwin stays up on his hill.

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Well you sure don't look like much. I'm glad you aren't the one guarding our gate.

shop_greeting.specifics: Ossian at the inn, Dunstan the smith, Mabry the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: Hello traveler. You know you're tracking mud all over my floor.

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: I hear the wolves are bold this year. Good for business, friend!

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: Strangers aren't usually welcome in my shop. But for a little extra gold, I'll overlook it this once.

two_givers.specifics: Halvard wants the tithe chest back from Corwin's tower, and Sly Wat wants back the wig Corwin's men took off his head when he deserted.

offer_a.speaker: Halvard
offer_a.text:
This is an outrage! Red Corwin's bandits have carried off the tithe chest of Brackenford -- the very coffers of this town!

They took it up to the old watchtower on Crow Hill, north of here. Recover the chest and you shall be handsomely rewarded.

offer_b.speaker: Sly Wat
offer_b.text:
Don't stare! I know, I know...

When I ran out on Corwin, his boys caught me at the bottom of the hill and took my wig! My beautiful wig! Now Corwin wears it himself, and the whole north road is laughing at Sly Wat!

Get it back for me and this chain tunic is yours.

outcome_a.speaker: Halvard
outcome_a.text:
The tithe chest! Safe and sound, and Corwin none the richer! Brackenford is in your debt.

Here is 150 gold, with the thanks of the whole town.

outcome_b.speaker: Sly Wat
outcome_b.text:
My wig! Oh, my beautiful wig! It smells of Corwin, but I don't care!

Here, the tunic's yours. Now let 'em laugh!

journal_a.text: Carry the tithe chest from Corwin's tower to the Moot Hall to give the town's money back to Halvard.

journal_b.text: Fight your way up Crow Hill and win back Sly Wat's wig from Red Corwin.

rescue.specifics: Anselm's novice Pip followed the Urchins into the old barrow and their shaman turned him into an Urchin.

plea.speaker: Anselm
plea.text:
Kind sir! Please, help us!

My novice Pip went into the old barrow across the ford after those Urchins, and he never came back. Last night an Urchin came scratching at the chapel door, crying my name in Pip's voice! Their shaman has turned the poor boy into one of them!

Bring him back to the Chapel of the Ford and I can lift the curse. Will you go?

reminder.speaker: Anselm
reminder.text: I've got my prayers to say. You fetch the boy.

found.speaker: Pip
found.text: Here's a human face at last and someone besides Urchins who might take me home!

following.speaker: Pip
following.text: No matter if the Urchins chase us clear to the ford! The chapel is holy ground. Even Urchins wouldn't dare set foot in the Chapel of the Ford!

completion.speaker: Anselm
completion.text:
Pip! Hold still, boy...

There! He's himself again! Not a whisker of Urchin left on him! Bless you, brave Adventurer!

Please, take this spell book. You have done the chapel a great service.

journal.text: Find Pip among the Urchins in the tunnels beneath the old barrow.

main_opening.specifics: A townsman points the player to Halvard in the Moot Hall, who sends him up Crow Hill after Red Corwin.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: Halvard is looking for someone brave! Hurry! The Moot Hall is just up the road!

opening.speaker: Halvard
opening.text:
Ah, at last! Someone who isn't afraid to walk the roads!

That villain Red Corwin and his bandits have seized the old watchtower on Crow Hill, north of town. They rob every cart and traveler on the north road, and I have had no choice but to shut the north gate. Brackenford cannot live long without its trade!

Go up Crow Hill and drive Corwin out of that tower. I will tell Garrick to open the gate for you. Off with you, lad, and good luck!

reminder.speaker: Halvard
reminder.text: Wanderer! Get up that hill at once!

journal.text: Go to the watchtower on Crow Hill and defeat Red Corwin.
